title: Al-Hayy: The Divine Name for Life, and the Verse That Calls the Other Gods Dead
excerpt: The word occurs 24 times in the Quran and only five name God. The other nineteen describe created things — and one of them is the verse that calls the idols dead, not living.
seo_title: Al-Hayy: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Hayy, the Ever-Living, appears 24 times in the Quran; only 5 name Allah. What al-Jalalayn concludes from 16:21, where the idols are called dead, not living.
